hero.lead: Court sports, coaching and recovery, in one place in Hong Kong.

venue.label: Venue
venue.desc: Courts by the hour for seven sports.

class.label: Class
class.desc: Sport classes, S&C sessions and certificate courses.

pt.label: Personal training
pt.desc: Pick your Just Performance coach, then a time. 1:1 to 1:Team, up to 16.

intro.title: A proper indoor venue, built for the sports Hong Kong actually plays.
intro.body1: Two indoor courts, one larger and one smaller, set up for whichever sport you book. There is also a strength and conditioning floor run by Just Performance, a recovery zone, changing rooms and lockers, and a small shop and supper corner.
intro.body2: Open to everyone. Book by the hour, join a class, or bring the whole office.

jp.title: Just Performance, in the building.
jp.body: Strength and conditioning by Just Performance, based here at Sporting Hub Hong Kong. Choose your coach first, then a time that suits you. Sessions run 1:1 to 1:Team, up to 16.

corp.title: Team days, tournaments, private hire.
corp.body: The whole venue or a single court. Tell us the date and headcount and we will come back with a quote.

band.title: Book a court
band.sub: Pick the sport, then the hour.

find.title: In Tsing Lung Tau, 25 minutes from Tsuen Wan.
find.addressValue: Hong Kong Garden shopping arcade, 100 Castle Peak Road, Tsing Lung Tau, N.T.
find.transportValue: MTR Tsuen Wan or Tsuen Wan West, then KMB bus 53 or minibus 302, about 25 minutes.
find.parkingValue: Public car park at Hong Kong Garden shopping arcade, hourly or daily.

footer.blurb: An indoor sports venue in Hong Kong. Courts, classes, coaching and kit.

bk.s1_sub: Pick your sport. Next, choose one hour or two in a row, up to 2 hours per HKID a day.
bk.s1c_sub: Sport, strength and conditioning, and certificates share one calendar.
bk.s5_sub: Personal training by Just Performance. Pick the coach, then their calendar.
bk.s5b_sub: Coach to athlete. Each ratio is priced differently.
bk.s2_note: Tap a start time. For two hours, also tap the hour just before or after it.
bk.s6_warn: Fill in your name, email and phone, and accept the waiver.
bk.c_waiv: I agree to the Terms of Service Policy
bk.c_mkt: Send me occasional news about classes and events.
bk.s7_sub: Nothing is charged in this prototype.
bk.s8_sub: A confirmation is on its way to your email.
bk.policy: Paid bookings are non-refundable and non-transferable. Exceptions: Typhoon Signal No. 8 or higher, or a Black Rainstorm Warning, issued within 2 hours before your slot; or a cancellation by us.
bk.cr_cat: This category step sits ahead of the standard Bliss flow. Confirm with Edward that it can be added without affecting other Bliss clients.
bk.cr_coach: Bliss goes store, then date, then time, then item. This picks the coach first. Confirm with Edward. Fallback: date first with a coach filter.
bk.cr_pay: Payment runs on the existing Bliss checkout and payment channel. Nothing new is built here.
bk.wa_prefill: Hi, I have a question about a booking.
bk.cr_cal: The Bliss backend renders the confirmation page, so an add to calendar button on it is a change request. Confirm with Edward.
bk.cr_qty: Up to 2 hours a day per HKID, in one continuous block (Siu, 2026-10-04). The page enforces the continuous block; the daily cap needs the backend to know what that HKID already booked. Confirm with Edward.
bk.f_hear: How did you hear about us?
bk.ratio_team_d: Up to 16 athletes with one coach.
bk.cr_split: The receipt itemises coaching and court hire as separate lines, charged in one transaction. Confirm with Edward.
bk.cr_eva: Training class registration should copy EVA's member registration questions exactly (client, 2026-09-24). Nobody has supplied EVA's field list, so this form is unchanged pending it.
bk.one_class: Each booking is for one class only, paid per class.
bk.one_pt: Coach to athlete. Each booking is for one session of one hour.
bk.night_sub: Night of {d1} into {d2}. The door opens with a QR code that comes with your booking.
bk.qr_valid: The code opens the door from {from} to {to}.
bk.qr_group: One code lets your whole group in.
bk.qr_shot: Screenshot this page now. We don't email the code.
bk.checkin_desk: Check in at the front desk with your HKID.
bk.cr_qr: Any booking that runs into 23:00 to 07:00 shows a QR code on this page instead of in the email (call, 2026-10-10). The Bliss backend generates the code. Each booking gets one code for the whole group, and it opens the door only between the booking's start and end, including after midnight. Not yet decided: which day a night booking counts toward for the 2-hour daily cap. Confirm with Edward.

sport.name: Sport classes
sport.desc: Classes in all seven court sports, grouped by age and level.

sc.name: Strength and conditioning
sc.desc: Group S and C sessions on the strength floor, run by Just Performance.

cert.name: Certificate courses
cert.desc: Multi-week courses that end in a certificate.

ws.name: Workshop
ws.desc: One-off clinics and short workshops, booked as a single session rather than a series.

c1.name: Volleyball, U12 Beginner
c1.desc: Serving, passing and rotation from zero.

c2.name: Badminton, Adult Intermediate
c2.desc: Rotating games for confident players. We sort the sides when you arrive.

c3.name: Strength and conditioning, Adult
c3.desc: Squat, hinge, press and carry. Barbell technique from the floor up.

c4.name: Mobility and recovery, Adult
c4.desc: Sled, bike and carries on the sled lane and turf. The barbell stays racked.

c5.name: Volleyball coaching certificate, Level 1
c5.desc: Six weeks, with an assessment and a certificate at the end.

w1.name: Serve and spike clinic
w1.desc: Two hours on the jump serve, the approach and the spike. Court shoes needed.

w2.name: Pickleball introduction workshop
w2.desc: Rules, grip and the kitchen line, with paddles provided. No experience needed.

8.name: 1 to Team
8.desc: Up to 16 athletes with one coach.

prices.title: Court hire
prices.hours: Peak hours are 16:00 to 23:00 Monday to Friday, and 07:00 to 23:00 on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays. All other hours are non-peak.
prices.memberBody: A one-off joining fee for sport classes. It covers your member account and a training kit.
prices.classTbc: Class and PT prices to confirm
prices.corpBody: We quote these case by case. Send us your date and group size.
prices.pdfTbc: Rate card waits on court sizes
prices.courtsNote: Volleyball and floorball are priced by court. Other sports go on whichever court is free.
